fixer.title: agentHost: wait for client tool result confirmation

introducer.title: agentHost: observe dispatched actions through a chat contribution hook

cases.mechanism: A client tool result that required user confirmation was immediately delivered to the provider, resolving its pending tool handler and starting a continuation model request before approval; denied results could therefore consume provider/network work that should never have started.
cases.symptom: An extra continuation model request and associated model inference/network latency could run while the UI was still waiting for result approval, and become entirely wasted when the user denied the result.
cases.fixedBehavior: The changed helper reads the reduced tool-call state, suppresses provider notification while status is PendingResultConfirmation, and forwards exactly once after approval or denial. This removes the eager provider continuation/model-network request from the user-confirmation wait path and also suppresses duplicate completion notifications during that wait.
cases.evidence: In the base revision, every server-origin ChatToolCallComplete reached _notifyClientToolCallComplete at line 485, which immediately called agent.onClientToolCallComplete and resolved the provider's parked client-tool handler. The Copilot implementation routes that result into the pending SDK tool call, allowing the provider to issue its continuation model request. The existing E2E scenario records model request bodies and establishes that the old call occurred while the tool state was still PendingResultConfirmation; the changed guard at line 1615 now returns while that state is pending and the new ChatToolCallResultConfirmed route resumes only after a decision.
